fileDescription: Strings for the Launch Arguments plugin.

pablogalbraith_launchargs.name: Launch Arguments
pablogalbraith_launchargs.description: Read the command-line arguments the exported app was launched with.

url-query-fallback.name: URL query fallback
url-query-fallback.desc: When not running in a supported desktop export (e.g. browser preview), read arguments from the page URL query string, e.g. ?level=3&fullscreen.

is-available.description: True if running in a supported desktop export and the native extension loaded.

has-flag.description: True if the named option was passed, with or without a value. Accepts "--name", "-n" or "name".

has-arg.description: True if any argument exactly matches the given text (case-sensitive, unparsed).

text.name: Text
text.desc: The exact argument text to look for.

arg-count.description: Number of arguments, not counting the executable.

arg-at.description: The raw argument at a zero-based index, or empty string if out of range.

arg-value.description: The value of a named option (--name=value or --name value). Returns the last value if repeated, or empty string if absent or a bare flag.

positional-at.description: The positional argument at a zero-based index, or empty string if out of range.

raw-command-line.description: The full command line as a single string.

executable-path.description: The path of the launched executable, as reported by the OS.

source.description: Where the arguments came from: "wrapper", "url" or "none".
